wallet.title: Agent Wallet
wallet.description: This is the AI agent's Stellar wallet. It holds USDC for paying pharmacies, medical bills, and API query fees. All balances are on Stellar testnet.
wallet.fundModalDesc: You'll be redirected to Circle's USDC faucet (an external website). Copy your wallet address above, paste it on their site, and they'll send you testnet USDC.
wallet.fundModalNote: This opens an external website. Make sure you're visiting Circle's official faucet, not a phishing site.
wallet.balanceUnavailable: Couldn't load balance. Check your connection or that the agent wallet is set up, then try again.
wallet.spendingByCategoryDesc: Where the agent's money went, from completed payments.
wallet.noSpendingInRange: No completed payments in this period.
wallet.rangeUnavailable: This agent only reports all-time totals, so the time range can't be changed.
wallet.networkFeesDesc: XLM paid to the Stellar network to submit payments. Tracked separately from medication and bill spending.
wallet.networkFeesNone: No network fees recorded in this period. Fees are recorded for payments the agent submits to Stellar itself (bill payments).
wallet.networkFeesSpikeNote: {days} day(s) had fees at least {multiplier}× the typical {typical} stroops per transaction, usually caused by network congestion.
wallet.networkFeesNoSpikes: No fee spikes in this period.
wallet.networkFeesUnavailable: This agent doesn't report network fees yet.
